svg.title: STC-10 · From brief to manifest in eight moves.
svg.desc: The eight-step Stagehand workflow for agents: U1 essence, fit test, U2 triptych, U3 ledger check, R intensity dial, E slot fills, T swap test, and the manifest line. Right: the precedence order when rules collide, from hard gates down to the theme card. Below: an example manifest line and the three intake values.
